code_excerpts.excerpt: class process_adapter { public: virtual bool spawn(const std::vector<std::string>& argv, int& child_pid) = 0; virtual bool send_signal(int pid, int signal) = 0; virtual bool is_alive(int pid) = 0; virtual bool wait_exit(int pid, int timeout_ms) = 0; };
code_excerpts.significance: Injectable interface for testability - same pattern as M2-002 backend_probe
Generation incremented on each launch, all error paths set state to failed

code_excerpts.excerpt: bool sooperlooper_process_supervisor::graceful_shutdown() { ... return m_adapter->wait_exit(m_child_pid, m_config.graceful_timeout_ms); } bool sooperlooper_process_supervisor::term_shutdown() { m_adapter->send_signal(m_child_pid, 15); return m_adapter->wait_exit(m_child_pid, m_config.term_timeout_ms); } bool sooperlooper_process_supervisor::kill_shutdown() { m_adapter->send_signal(m_child_pid, 9); return m_adapter->wait_exit(m_child_pid, 1000); }
code_excerpts.significance: Bounded shutdown escalation: graceful -> SIGTERM -> SIGKILL

code_excerpts.excerpt: class fake_process_adapter : public seq66::process_adapter { ... bool sigkill_always_works{true}; ... bool wait_exit(int pid, int /* timeout_ms */) override { if (sigkill_always_works && last_signal_num == 9) return true; return wait_exits; } };
code_excerpts.significance: Fake adapter models SIGKILL as unblockable for realistic escalation tests

constraints: Seq66 owns process lifecycle and intent (ARCHITECTURE.md)
No UI or real-time path blocks on process operations (THREAD-001)
Owned-child-only signaling (never kill externally discovered processes)
Backend probe (M2-002) consumed by caller, not by supervisor
Fake-process tests cover start, stop, restart, identity verification
No synchronous waits on UI/RT paths

key_design_decisions: Injectable process_adapter interface (same pattern as M2-002 backend probe)
SIGKILL is always the final escalation and is modeled as unblockable

launch() does not reset restart_count (only explicit reset or fresh instance)
Config immutability enforced while process is running or starting
